newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hochtief - DVFA 1996 earnings per share fell.
newsitem.headline: Hochtief - DVFA 1996 earnings per share fell.

text.p: German construction group Hochtief AG said on Tuesday that its 1996 earnings per share according to DVFA accounting rules was 3.20 marks versus 3.70 marks previously.
The firm also said that it had written off more than 323 million marks in 1996 for its holdings in fellow construction firm Holzmann AG and for other financial investments.
Hochtief's chief executive, Hans Peter Keitel, told a news conference that a fall in Hochtief's share price late in 1996 was due in most part to this write-off.
Keitel said the write-off had not been necessary to fulfil accounting rules, but was possible under the system.
He added that Hochtief also booked costs of around 130 million marks in 1996 due to restructuring for staff lay-offs.
